Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: An early two-part Craig Jones passing course (about 70 minutes) on passing the guard with the threat of leg attacks in the background. Part 1 covers his passing position, knee cut variations (including the same-side knee cut) and the smash pass. Part 2 covers the knee pummel pass, the 'Khabib' wrist ride, more smash passing and 'the TJ pass'. Marked outdated in your collection because his later Power Top course replaced it.
Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi passers; a short, quick watch.

Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Craig Jones' riding and pinning system in six volumes (about 4 hours), built on the B-Team idea that points don't equal control. Volume 1 covers how movement and power are created. Volume 2 covers leg control (splits and rides). Volume 3 covers upper body tools (crossface, claw, half nelson and others). Volume 4 covers controlling the turtle (kosoto hook, cradle, spiral rides). Volume 5 covers entries from side control, mount and knee ride. Volume 6 covers going from control to submissions (arm triangle, 'baby seal' and others).
Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: Top players who want to keep people down and wear them out; wrestlers moving to submission grappling.
key: Upper body controls: crossface, claw, half nelson
